name: The Binding
summary: At Neeru Fireblade's circle in Orgrimmar, a warlock faces the trial of binding a succubus. Dogran's Pendant draws the demon from the Twisting Nether, where spellcraft and force of arms must break its will.

sections.title: A Demon's Anchor
sections.body: Dogran's Pendant binds memory to the summoning. The maimed orc gave it up, but it had been a keepsake of his love for Zankaja, carried through captivity and torment. That devotion gives the pendant the force to reach across realms, bridge the Twisting Nether, and seize a succubus's attention.

sections.title: The Circle in the Shadows
sections.body: Beneath the clefts of Orgrimmar, Neeru Fireblade keeps a tent with a circle prepared for dangerous rites. Under Gan'rul Bloodeye's guidance, you activate its runes and face the summoned succubus in battle. Calling a demon is only the beginning; you must overpower it alone and bend its spirit to your will.

sections.title: Wiles and Willpower
sections.body: Gan'rul Bloodeye warns that succubi can make dangerous thralls. Their presence intoxicates and tempts the senses, while they drain the vitality and spirit of careless masters. He tells you to remember Dogran and Zankaja's sorrow, lest pride and overconfidence leave you open to the demon's wiles. Only an unyielding will can resist its allure.

aliases: what do you do in the binding
faq.answer: You bring Dogran's Pendant to the circle inside Neeru Fireblade's tent in the Cleft of Shadow. Its devotion draws a succubus from the Twisting Nether, and you battle the demon until it submits to your will.

faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?
aliases: where do i summon the succubus
faq.answer: The summoning takes place in Neeru Fireblade's tent in the Cleft of Shadow, beneath Orgrimmar. A ritual circle is inscribed in the floor.

faq.q: Who was Dogran and why is his pendant needed?
faq.answer: Dogran was a Horde grunt captured and maimed by quilboar in the Barrens. His pendant, a keepsake of his beloved Zankaja, draws and anchors a succubus.
Gan'rul Bloodeye is a senior warlock trainer in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He mentors rising warlocks and guides them through rites of demon subjugation.

faq.q: What power does a warlock gain upon completing this trial?
faq.answer: Subduing the succubus completes a warlock's training and grants the knowledge and runic mastery to summon one into service at any time.

faq.q: Why is summoning a succubus considered especially dangerous?
faq.answer: Succubi charm mortals and play on their desires. An overconfident warlock risks having their soul slowly siphoned away, until the demon's guile overcomes their command.

angles.text: As a warlock, you prove your will can master the cunning, disruptive demons of the Nether and withstand their seductive perils.
As a member of the Horde, you see how the faction tolerates demonic practitioners in secret within the Cleft of Shadow, away from the city's honor-bound populace.
As an orc, you carry the bitter weight of your people's past corruption when dealing with demons. Gan'rul's demand for discipline and control bears that history.
